name: Sakurairo no Rengi
source:
A noblewoman who was the daughter of the Aizu warriors in the final days of the Edo era, meets with four men in the new era. What is their past relationship to this woman?

They were lovers.....

But who is her lover today!?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ111144.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
江户时代末期的会津武士的女儿，贵妇，与新时代的四名男子相遇。他们和这个女人过去是什么关系？

他们曾经是恋人……

但今天她的爱人是谁！？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ111144.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
